text:
Lina: Morning team — quick sunup handoff. Night shift saw a spike of 503s for embedding requests around 03:12 UTC, mostly in eu-west. Pager -> two pages, one auto-escalated. We mitigated by failing over a subset of traffic to the cheaper-rt fallback model and throttling bursty client X for 10m. Customer impact: intermittent embedding latency and ~10% failed requests for a 15m window for a small cohort. No SLA breach reported so far.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0427 (embedding-503-eu-west). Pages: 2. Severity: P2. Current status: monitoring. Pager log: 
```
[03:12:08] 503 spike: embedding service - kv-cache miss surge
[03:14:30] failover triggered -> route eu-west to variant-r2
[03:22:10] client X throttled via rate-limit-rule #embed-burst
```

Ryan: Thanks Lina. Do we know root cause? Was it autoscaler slow-start or sudden KV eviction?

Lina: Initial signs point to a combination: upstream batcher queued long tail + redis evictions in eu-west AZ-b. Autoscaler didn't add fast enough for the burst due to cooldown settings. We're tracking as two follow-ups.

Alex: Oncall note — I ran the short health probe (logs attached to the incident). Added temporary autoscale-policy tweak for eu-west (lower cooldown, added 2x burst nodes) as a safe-canary for 30m. Watch p95 and CPU. Link to canary config: https://internal.redwood.dev/runbooks/embeddings/canary-eu-west (internal).

ops-bot: Autoscaler change deployed by Alex at 03:28 UTC (deploy-id: deploy-9921). No rollback needed.

Seema: I'll own the postmortem starter doc. Planned fields: timeline, actions, root cause hypotheses, recommended tuning (autoscaler cooldown, redis eviction thresholds), and customer outreach draft. Aiming for PM draft by EOD.

Chris: Heads up — APAC routing currently has a coverage gap 00:00-06:00 PT where our secondary oncall is not scheduled. If we need follow-up checks during daytime APAC spike windows, we may be short. Alex — can we keep a light pager coverage overlap tomorrow 00:00-03:00 PT?

Ben: Short-term mitigation suggestion — enable prefix caching for highest-volume prefixes for 2h, reduces KV pressure. Command I used yesterday in staging: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.internal/kvcache/enable \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"prefixes":["/embed/v1/vecs/highfreq"], "ttl":7200}'
```
If approved, ops-bot can run with a scheduled window.

Lina: Good idea Ben. Approve cache patch for 2h during morning window. Seema — include this in the timeline. Alex — please leave autoscaler canary running until 04:00 UTC and then scale down if p95 stable.

Alex: ACK, will monitor p95, qps and memory. If p95 < 250ms for 20m, I'll scale down.

Seema: PM note — drafting customer message for the affected cohort: apology, summary of cause (in flight), mitigation steps we took, next steps, ETA for full postmortem. Will sync w/comms.

Ryan: Two action items for next shift: 1) validate redis eviction configs with infra, 2) confirm client X's retry/backoff pattern doesn't aggressively retry and worsen the spike. I'll take #2. Lina, can you own #1?

Lina: I will ping infra and get a quick check. Putting owners: infra-check -> Lina, client-retries -> Ryan, postmortem -> Seema, autoscaler-watch -> Alex, cache-deploy -> Ben.

ops-bot: Reminder: Runbook link for embeddings incidents: https://internal.redwood.dev/runbooks/embeddings/incident-playbook. Follow checklist items 1-6 (traffic isolation, kv-cache pinning, temporary throttles, canary autoscale).

Chris: Confirming coverage — I'll extend my oncall overlap tomorrow by 2 hours to cover APAC morning window. Noted.

Ben: I'll prepare the cache enable job and give ops-bot the go-ahead to run it on your signal.

Lina: Final checklist before I hand off: 
- Incident INC-2026-0427 is in monitoring (reduced error rate).
- Owners assigned (infra: Lina, retries: Ryan, postmortem: Seema, autoscale: Alex, cache: Ben).
- APAC coverage extended (Chris).
- Runbook links posted above.

If nothing critical pops up, primary for night -> Alex (monitor autoscaler), secondary -> Ryan. I'm going offline in ~15m. Ping me if anything til then. :thumbsup:
